goal: Move the unchanged dual-view specialist failure-localization counterfactual audit from Magnolia login-node CPU to one P100 inference-only job after CPU execution proved impractically slow.

evidence.v0_2_runtime_observation: checkpoint 40 counterfactual exceeded ~25 minutes on login-node CPU

method_lessons: Do not treat compute-placement failure as model evidence.

Preserve interrupted diagnostic directories and move the unchanged scientific test to a better execution substrate.
